d: Company Description Habib Bakery is one of the oldest and most established bakeries in Dubai, known for its commitment to quality, tradition, and exceptional service. Operating 24 hours a day, the bakery offers over 300 varieties of products, including freshly baked bread, pastries, and savory items that cater to a wide range of tastes. With 5 locations across Dubai and Sharjah, Habib Bakery is expanding its reach and bringing authentic cakes and desserts to more customers and corporate events. The bakery specializes in bespoke whole cakes and cupcakes that can be customized to match specific brands, color schemes, and event themes. Habib Bakery continues to grow as a trusted destination where every moment is treated as a celebration of taste.

Role Description The Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This role is responsible for overseeing daily bakery operations across multiple locations, ensuring consistent product quality, timely production, and efficient service delivery. The Operations Manager will manage staffing schedules, coordinate with production and sales teams, monitor inventory levels, and implement health, safety, and food hygiene standards. The role includes optimizing workflows, controlling costs, and improving operational processes to support 24/7 operations and peak demand periods. The Operations Manager will also collaborate with leadership on performance metrics, vendor relationships, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
q: Strong operations management skills, including workflow optimization, process improvement, and cost control in a food production or retail environment.
Experience with staff supervision, team leadership, and scheduling for shift-based operations.
Knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards, and compliance with local health regulations.
Ability to manage inventory, procurement, and vendor relationships effectively.
Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience using data to drive decisions.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate across production, sales, and delivery teams.
Experience in bakery, F&B, hospitality, or FMCG operations is highly beneficial.
Proficiency with basic business software (e.g., MS Office, inventory or POS systems).
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support 24/7 operations.
